title: 第9章 第二案：水泥藏尸（2）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

回家路上。

念念乖巧跟在李安国身后。

李安国走，她也走。

李安国停，她也停。

好几次李安国回头，嘴巴都张开了，犹豫几秒又闭上。

念念小脑袋低垂，不敢抬头去看李安国脸上的表情。

恰好错过李安国眼里那一闪而过的愧疚。

“念念。”

念念心口一紧，僵硬站在原地。

两只小手紧紧揪着衣角，不知道该作何反应。

直到李安国蹲下，从怀里掏出一个红本本，“念念，你看这是什么？”

念念眨眼。

认真数起上面的字。

“1，2，3，4，5……”

李安国：(；￣д￣)

“你是不是不识字？”

念念拘谨的搓着小手，微不可察的点了点头。

但下一秒，她就立马说道：“李叔叔，念念不识字是因为没钱读书，但你放心！念念有办法！

念念明天就去学校里捡破烂。

这样既不耽误赚钱，又可以听到老师讲课。

念念一定会努力学的！

所以，李叔叔，你能不能不要抛弃念念？念念会乖的。”

李安国哭笑不得的摆了摆手。

“我不是这个意思。

我的意思是收养手续已经办下来了。

以后我就是你爸爸。”

怕念念不信，李安国还

登记证右上角贴着一张照片。

照片上的人正是李安国和念念。

一大一小两个脑袋靠在一起。

动作僵硬却透着一丝亲昵。

念念：(灬°ω°灬)

这个她见过！

福利院里被领养走的孩子，都有一本！

“李叔叔，这个红本本能给念念吗？

这样以后念念找不到你，就可以拿红本本去告你。”

李安国：！！！

他可是……咳咳。

总之他是不可能遗弃念念的！

他可是一个负责任的男人！

李安国伸手点了一下念念的小脑瓜，嗔怪道：“一天天净瞎琢磨。”

念念吐舌。

抱着收养证跑得飞快。

回到家，念念就像一只忙碌的小蜜蜂。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the way home.

Nian Nian followed Li Anguo obediently.

When Li Anguo left, she left too.

When Li Anguo stopped, she stopped too.

Several times Li Anguo turned around and opened his mouth, hesitated for a few seconds and then closed it again.

Nian Nian lowered her head, not daring to raise her head to see the expression on Li Anguo's face.

I happened to miss the flash of guilt in Li Anguo's eyes.

"Nian Nian."

Nian Nian's heart tightened and she stood stiffly.

His two little hands grasped the corners of his clothes tightly, not knowing how to react.

Until Li Anguo squatted down and took out a red notebook from his arms, "Nian Nian, what do you think this is?"

Nian Nian blinked.

Count the words above carefully.

"1, 2, 3, 4, 5..."

Li Anguo: (；￣д￣)

"Are you illiterate?"

Nian Nian rubbed her little hands cautiously and nodded imperceptibly.

But the next second, she immediately said: "Uncle Li, Niannian is illiterate because she has no money to study, but don't worry! Niannian has a way!

Nian Nian will go to school to pick up rags tomorrow.

In this way, you will not delay making money, but you can also listen to the teacher's lectures.

Niannian will definitely study hard!

So, Uncle Li, can you not abandon Niannian?Nian Nian will be good."

Li Anguo waved his hands in confusion.

"That's not what I meant.

What I mean is that the adoption procedures have been completed.

I will be your father from now on."

Afraid that Niannian would not believe it, Li Anguo returned

There is a photo affixed to the upper right corner of the registration certificate.

The people in the photo are none other than Li Anguo and Niannian.

The heads of one big and one small are close together.

The movements were stiff but there was a hint of intimacy.

Nian Nian: (灬°ω°灬)

She has seen this before!

All adopted children in the orphanage have a copy!

“Uncle Li, can I give this red book to Nian Nian?

In this way, if Nian Nian can't find you in the future, she can sue you with the red book."

Li Anguo:!!!

He is...ahem.

In short, it is impossible for him to abandon Nian Nian!

He is a responsible man!

Li Anguo stretched out his hand and tapped Nian Nian's little head, scolding: "I am just thinking blindly every day."

Nian Nian sticks out his tongue.

He ran very fast holding the adoption certificate.

When I got home, Nian Nian was like a busy little bee.
